ask: Staff-to-child ratio for the youngest age group the rulebook sets (usually infants). Answer: children per staff member.
Staff-to-child ratio for 3-year-olds. Answer: children per staff member.
Staff-to-child ratio for 4-year-olds. Answer: children per staff member.
Staff-to-child ratio for school-age children (use the oldest school-age band if there are several). Answer: children per staff member.
Maximum group size for 4-year-olds. Answer: number of children.
Minimum age for a caregiver/teacher counted in ratio (not an aide or volunteer unless the rule says so). Answer: years.
One concrete minimum qualification for a center director (education, credential or experience). Answer: short text.
Hours of ongoing/annual training required for caregiving staff per year. Answer: hours.
Minimum usable indoor space per child. Answer: square feet.
Minimum outdoor play space per child (per child on the playground at one time, or per licensed capacity: say which). Answer: square feet.
Maximum hot water temperature at sinks/taps children use. Answer: degrees Fahrenheit.
What must the center have before giving a child medication (e.g. written parent authorization)? Answer: short text.
How often fire (evacuation) drills must be held. Answer: short text, e.g. 'monthly'.
How long a specific record (attendance, child records, medication log, etc.: name it) must be kept. Answer: duration.
Required sleep position for infants. Answer: short text.
Deadline to report a serious injury/incident to the licensing agency (or to parents if that's all the rule sets: say which). Answer: duration.
When a child's immunization record must be on file (e.g. on admission, within N days). Answer: short text or days.
CPR/first-aid requirement: how many/which staff must be certified, or present at all times. Answer: short text.
Minimum distance between cribs or cots/mats. Answer: inches or feet.
How long a license is valid, or how often it must be renewed. Answer: duration.
